descriptionChirho: To ascribe or attribute honor, glory, or greatness to God, used in cultic and worship contexts.
The basic sense of giving, handing over, or providing something to someone, covering both singular and plural imperative forms.
Used as an interjection or exhortation meaning 'come!' or 'come now!', urging action or participation.
To set or place something in a particular location or position.
